notes.title: Kickstarter Coming Soon! + New Trailer!
notes.content:
🔎Kickstarter Coming Soon!
I'm looking at launching a Kickstarter soon, potentially in October! This is to fund the OST that Fatbard (Bubsy 4D, Crashlands 2, Die in the Dungeon) is putting together, and it's going to be awesome!



Follow Mansions of a Million Monsters! on Kickstarter by clicking here!


🔎Updated Trailer!
I've been hard at work this summer adding LOTS of new art, content, and QOL features to Mansion of a Million Monsters!, and created a new trailer to showcase it! Check it out on the store page!

[img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3627210/008308e5ae5fda4c6d323bc764e0e7dde86c90e1/ss_008308e5ae5fda4c6d323bc764e0e7dde86c90e1.1920x1080.jpg?t=1758143502"]

I couldn't fit everything into the new trailer, but if you want to see development previews, you can follow along on BlueSky or TikTok using the links below!
